title: Dimension-free KLS Poincare bound for isotropic log-concave densities (smooth compactly supported tests)
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib library for Poincare inequalities, log-concave probability measures and stochastic localization. Its dimension-free KLS theorem bounds the intrinsic local-slope Poincare constant by one universal constant times the covariance operator norm, including dimension zero and singular affine supports, for log-concave probability laws with finite second moment. The proof follows Bizeul-Klartag-Lehec through finite-horizon cutoff localization, the compact Letwin constant-8 quadratic variance bound and approximation. Supporting results include Cheeger-Buser comparisons, covariance and energy interfaces and moment-map calculus. This entry checks the pinned OpenAI density formulation: for every n >= 1 and isotropic measurable log-concave probability density, Var(f) <= C * E|grad f|^2 for every smooth compactly supported real test, with one positive C before all dimensions and laws. No numerical final KLS constant, formal equivalence with the paper's locally Lipschitz L^2 test class, or uncut Eldan construction is claimed.
